decisions.reason: Quotes the exact disabled expression, establishes busy as a free identifier local to sibling AttachButton, and explains both the empty-occurrences early return and the plain-phase falsy-guard path evaluating busy into a ReferenceError.

Explains the render throw is caught by the slot-level error boundary which unmounts the entire slot entry (whole dock), the separate AttachButton slot survives, and the diagnostic is a console-only ReferenceError with no UI banner.

Cites the shipped v0.2.10 expression to attribute busy to the baseline, notes the diff misleadingly renders the old line, proposes rollback/re-add and a data-present plain-phase minimal mount, and flags the imageItem-outside-callback scope defect; keeps historical-exercise claims appropriately unproven.

Restores the phase-only guard or properly lifts owned busy state; hardens with (record?.items ?? []).find and event.target.closest?; moves imageItem inside the callback where record/status are scoped.

Provides a concrete plain-phase occurrence render test asserting chip/remove DOM presence and no boundary capture, explains empty-state-only tests miss the line and that node --check cannot see runtime free identifiers, and includes a data-present render smoke as the mandatory pre-ship check.
